name: Fenrius
backstory: Child of Fenserika and Nierius; raised in Salthos Cruzados on waits near the Salthos house's own square on..., and carries some knowledge of Toll Ledger Arrears.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Learned that Darius has died.
Grew up hearing: Heard that Nakus and Darnus now have a child, Darnakus.
Grew up hearing: Had a child with Darius, named Darika.
Heard that Nierius and Magus now have a child, Nieragus.
Heard that Darnus and Fenserika now have a child, Fenarnus.
Had a child with Dorukus, named Fenriukas.
Heard that Nakoran and Fenserika now have a child, Nakorika.
Heard that Dornakus and Darika now have a child, Dornarika.
Had a child with Dornakus, named Dornarius.
Heard that Nieragus and Dorakus now have a child, Nieradus.
Heard that Fenserika and Niekus now have a child, Fenekus.
Heard that Darika and Darnakus now have a child, Darinak.
Heard that Fenriukas and Niemornak now have a child, Niemoruk.
Heard that Dornakus and Doraknus now have a child, Dornaknis.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only by making Forliamus Betrothal Offer their own concern
criterion.wasted_life: treating Forliamus Betrothal Offer as someone else's concern
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: stands at the square's edge on petition days, has stopped expecting an answer about the old match, and instead keeps track of who else the house has left waiting

arc.premise: Fenrius wants a permanent board raised at the square itself - every betrothal, sealed or refused, nailed up in plain sight - rather than trusting it to a book someone can misplace or an official can quietly bury.
